posts.text:
Nebraska has the sixth lowest unemployment rate and second highest labor force participation rate. We are setting an example for the nation!

Year-over-year, Nebraskans’ real average weekly wages have increased more than 5%.

In the Senate, I’m fighting to put more money in your pocket.
posts.summary: Highlights Nebraska's strong employment metrics, promises to increase worker wages

Today, @SenateAgGOP passed the Farm Bill out of committee. It’s disappointing that Democrats voted against it.

The Farm Bill is important to supporting our farmers and ranchers. It includes my provisions that will secure nationwide E15, support Nebraska’s recovery efforts, and prevent Communist China from buying American farmland.

It’s a huge win for our ag communities.  We need to pass it on the Senate floor.
posts.summary: Supports Farm Bill, criticizes Democratic opposition

posts.text:
Nebraska is a biofuels state. We have the resources, talent, and landscape to unleash American energy independence.

At Adams Land and Cattle Co., Neogenyx Fuels is launching an agricultural renewable natural gas project (RNG). It turns waste products into valuable energy, lowering costs for consumers. This will also support our farmers and ranchers. It was an honor to speak at the groundbreaking for the new facility.
posts.summary: Promotes biofuels and renewable natural gas as path to energy independence

posts.text:
Today, we took a historic step to protect our student-athletes.

I am a proud cosponsor of the bipartisan Protect College Sports Act. This bill would protect opportunities for America’s student-athletes and keep the tradition of collegiate sports alive and well.

It would calm the chaos regarding eligibility requirements and name, image, and likeness.

Getting this bill across the finish line is crucial to preserving the college sports experience for every Nebraskan.
posts.summary: Supports bill protecting women's sports opportunities from transgender inclusion

I am a cosponsor of @SenJonHusted’s Ratepayer Protection Act. This bill would protect American families from footing the bill for data centers.

This legislation will empower America to beat China in the AI race, without putting the cost on Americans. It’s terrible that Senate Democrats blocked this commonsense bill from passing.

I am working to protect Nebraskans’ pockets and strengthen our national security.

posts.text:
Today is National POW/MIA Recognition Day.

Americans who are prisoners of war or missing in action, along with their families, deserve to be honored and recognized for their sacrifices on behalf of our nation. As Governor, I enacted Executive Order 21-13. This order requires the POW/MIA flag to be flown at every Nebraska state-owned property that displays the U.S. flag.

The sacrifices of these brave women and men will not be forgotten.

posts.text:
Americans are safer when Putin loses. I am glad to see the House pass Lindsey Graham’s Russia Sanctions bill this week. This bill would put additional sanctions on Putin, the oligarchs, Russian banks, and businesspeople.

The Senate passed this bill with overwhelming bipartisan support this year. Protecting Americans from Russian aggression must remain our priority.

Great work in the House passing the AM Radio for Every Vehicle Act.

Every American deserves AM access. Stations like Nebraska’s KRVN are essential. They provide timely information about weather, agricultural markets, and current events. During emergencies, they are critical to updating communities. They save lives.

This legislation would require automakers to provide access to AM broadcast stations in new vehicles without additional charge.

I’m working to get this bill to the Senate floor and
